p.s: Dear Maria Smith,
I receved your letter and I'm happy to help you.
We booked the Palace Hotel for your group, it's nice and quiet.
I'm sure you'll be fine here.
We chose the Palace Hotel because it's near our college, too.
So you are going to come at the conference in some minutes.
When you go out of the Hotel turn right and go stright on, at the first crossroads turn right again.
At the end of this street you can see our college on your left, it's a green building.
At the end-of-conference party it'll be something to eat and to drink.
In the big room where we'll have the party, it'll be some picturs of our college, you'll see al the generations who passed here.
The wears aren't very important, but it'll be fine if the people will wear something different from the usual jeans.
Here we have a lot of beautiful things to do, but the best you can do in about three hours is visiting the painting museum.
We all are looking forward to seeing your group.
Yours sincerely,

p.s: TELEVISION
What would our world be without television?
It isn't easy giving an answer at this question.
Television is an important invention, it permitted us to better our way of communication.
This animated box can give us a lot of informations coming from all around the world.
Television has affected the "all days life,,, too.
We can spend a lot of time enjoying ourselves with some programs, all what we have to do is watching.
And we like that, because it's easier nothing doing than engaging ourselves in something that make us do something.
So television can be a positive or a negative invention, it depends on which use we want to do of this box.
Now we should be able to answer at the introducing question.
No, I don't think so.
Television has become so important for us that we can't thinking that it couldn't exist.
